title: Edgar Fouché's Defense Advanced Research Center at S4

tellings.quote: Edgar Fuche who claimed that S4 ran the Defense Advanced Research Center the DAR which was found in um a apa document in the 70s to be proposed

plain: S4, a secret site in Nevada, ran something called the Defense Advanced Research Center, according to a man named Edgar Fouché. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels about the claim and says a center by that name shows up as a proposal in a 1970s document from ARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency. He also names a man called Dan Burisch, and the point is that the paper would show the center was at least planned.
